CHROMATIC 1.0 — Windows x64 UCI

Register chromatic.exe in a UCI chess GUI. Keep default.zero beside it.
The engine does not call Python, PyTorch or another chess engine.
Standard Microsoft Visual C++ runtime is required.

Default model: original 128-position / 200-step bootstrap weights.
No newly trained candidate has passed the promotion gate.

Default options:
  InferenceBackend = SIMD (FP32 SSE2, no quantization)
  SparsePolicyHead = true
  CPuct = 1.5
  FPUReduction = 0
  MateProofNodes = 256
  MateProofPlies = 1
  Simulations = 800
  MaxNodes = 100000
  TreeMemoryMB = 64

Diagnostic deep proof: MateProofNodes=12000, MateProofPlies=5.
This spends additional time and is not the default.

v0.1 arithmetic/search trace comparison:
  InferenceBackend=Scalar, MateProofNodes=0

Supported: uci, isready, ucinewgame, position, go, stop, quit.
Use go nodes N or go movetime MS for measurements.
go depth N is a compatibility mapping to N*100 root updates.
No ponder, Chess960, shared-tree parallel search or MultiPV.

UCI nodes counts root updates, including proof-backed updates.
Proof traversal work is recorded separately by the JSON extension.
See README.md, PERFORMANCE.md and STRENGTH_REPORT.md in the source package.
